title: Bulk Slash
overview:
I'm counting on your voice!!

Your partners in battle are seven beautiful girl navigators!

No more blind spots! Read the enemy's moves! Shockingly thrilling battles!

A lavish voice cast voices the beautiful girl navigators!

Character design by Kunihiko Natsume!

After losing an interplanetary war, the people of planet Brau face discrimination, and a former military chief launches a coup. Young pilot Cress Dolly joins the elite squad formed to put down the uprising.

Take the controls of the Garduel, a two-seat fighter that transforms into a robot, in this 3D action shooting game. Battle through seven stages, from city streets to enemy fleets in space and an enemy fortress. Your onboard navigator calls out enemies and items as you fight, and each navigator's level rises as you meet her goals, such as score or clear time.

君の声が頼りだ！！

戦いのパートナーは、7人の美少女ナビゲーター！

死角が消える！敵の動きが読める！衝撃のスリリング・バトル！

豪華声優陣が、美少女ナビゲーターの声を担当！

キャラクターデザインには、夏目久仁彦氏を起用！
